label: BLOCK 03
prompt:
DURATION: 15 SECONDS
FORMAT: HORIZONTAL 16:9

Create four cinematic live-action shots showing Zahhak’s absolute control over two suspended women.

Z01: 00:00–00:04.
Z02: 00:04–00:07.
Z03: 00:07–00:11.
Z04: 00:11–00:15.

This entire block takes place during the sustained levitation.
Both women are already suspended 1.2 meters above the floor.
They remain at that height throughout.
Zahhak’s staff remains raised through the final frame.

The emotional center is effortless control.
Zahhak’s stillness contrasts with the force acting on the women.


CHARACTER REFERENCES

Zahhak: {{CHAR_ZAHHAK}}

Preserve his exact sculptural mask, costume, body proportions,
hands and established living shoulder serpents.

His mask remains a rigid object.
His performance comes from head angle, posture, breathing
and the precision of his right hand.

His living serpents move independently:
slow neck flexion, small directional head turns,
and elongated bodies sliding against the garment.

Each serpent has one head and one continuous elongated body.
Preserve their established attachment and emergence points.

Shahrnaz: {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}

Preserve her exact identity, mask, hairstyle, costume and proportions.
Her real eyes remain behind the existing mask openings.
She holds the cat securely against her chest.

Arnavaz: {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}

Preserve her exact identity, mask, hairstyle, costume and proportions.
Preserve the existing dust on her left garment
and her slightly lowered left shoulder.
Her hands remain empty.

Both women’s masks retain their rigid geometry.
Their eye openings remain fixed in shape.


ANIMAL REFERENCE

Shahrnaz’s cat: {{ANIMAL_CAT}}

Preserve its exact appearance and size.

Shahrnaz’s left forearm supports its abdomen and hindquarters.
Her right hand supports its chest.
The animal remains sheltered against her torso throughout.


PROP REFERENCE

Serpent-headed staff: {{PROP_STAFF}}

Preserve the exact referenced design, dimensions and materials.

Its carved serpent head is rigid and inanimate,
visually distinct from Zahhak’s living shoulder serpents.

Zahhak holds the staff in his RIGHT hand throughout.
His right forearm is raised, presenting the carved head
toward the midpoint between the suspended women.

His left hand rests low beside his body.


STARTING STATE AND FIXED BLOCKING

Zahhak stands firmly on the floor at SCREEN LEFT,
facing SCREEN RIGHT toward the sisters.

Shahrnaz occupies CENTER-RIGHT, nearer the camera.
Arnavaz occupies the deeper RIGHT position,
80 centimeters farther from the camera
and 45 centimeters farther screen right than Shahrnaz.

Both women face SCREEN LEFT toward Zahhak.

Their feet hang 1.2 meters above the floor.
Their bodies remain vertically above their original footprints.
Their horizontal spacing remains unchanged.

Zahhak stands approximately 1.5 meters from Shahrnaz’s
horizontal floor position.

All four camera positions remain on the same side of the action axis.
Zahhak consistently looks toward SCREEN RIGHT.
The women consistently face toward SCREEN LEFT.

The sisters remain off-screen right during Zahhak’s close-ups.
Their breathing and wind-driven clothing remain audible.


LIGHTING AND FLOOR

The surrounding chamber disappears into solid blackness.

Optional lighting reference:
[ASSIGN AN APPROVED BLACK-BACKGROUND SPOTLIGHT FRAME]

Use character references for identity and physical design.
Relight them according to this scene.

One fixed, hard, cold-neutral spotlight shines vertically down
over Zahhak and the suspended women.

Upper mask planes, shoulders, hands, serpent scales
and the carved staff catch narrow, hard highlights.

The lower half of Zahhak’s mask falls into deep shadow.
His upper mask contour remains readable against blackness.

Keep the spotlight’s direction, intensity and color constant.
Maintain locked exposure across all four shots.

The floor is one smooth, matte charcoal architectural plane,
perfectly level and continuous in every direction.

In the wide shot, a limited patch of illumination reveals this
same flat surface beneath Zahhak and beneath the women.

The boundary of that patch is only a change in light.
The floor retains one uniform elevation across the entire scene.

The gap between the suspended feet and the floor
contains visibly empty air.


AIRFLOW AND PERFORMANCE

Strong, localized upward airflow surrounds the sisters.
Their loose hair streams upward and sideways.
Free garment panels snap, curl and ripple around their legs.

Their bodies retain their orientation and horizontal positions.
Small involuntary tremors pass through their shoulders and hands.

Shahrnaz maintains her supportive hold on the cat.

Zahhak stands outside the strongest airflow.
His heavy costume hangs close to his grounded body.
Only a loose outer edge occasionally stirs.

His breathing is slow.
His shoulders remain relaxed.
His control appears physically effortless.


SHOT Z01 — THE GROUNDED FIGURE
00:00–00:04

32mm low-angle medium close-up from the established camera side.

Place the camera approximately 70 centimeters above the floor,
looking upward at Zahhak’s torso and mask.

Zahhak occupies SCREEN LEFT and CENTER.
His masked face is seen in three-quarter view,
directed toward SCREEN RIGHT.

Include his raised right forearm and the carved staff head.
The suspended women remain outside the right edge of frame.

The camera advances approximately 20 centimeters over four seconds,
with restrained human handheld movement.

Zahhak gradually angles his head upward by a few degrees,
attending to the women above his eye level.

His torso stays still.
His right arm maintains the staff at the same height.

One living shoulder serpent makes a small muscular adjustment.

Strong wind and snapping cloth remain audible from off-screen right.
Zahhak’s own heavy clothing stays almost motionless.

Cut while his upward attention holds.


SHOT Z02 — THE RELAXED GRIP
00:04–00:07

85mm close-up of Zahhak’s RIGHT hand around the staff shaft.

Place the hand at the center of the frame.
The raised shaft passes diagonally upward toward SCREEN RIGHT.
His dark sleeve occupies the background behind the hand.

Preserve the staff’s height and angle from the preceding shot.

Begin with visible tension in the knuckles.

Zahhak slowly eases his grip:
his ring finger and little finger relax slightly,
while his thumb, index finger and middle finger maintain
secure contact with the shaft.

The staff remains steady in his hand.
The women remain suspended off-screen.

Keep focus on the fingers and the material beneath them.
Use barely perceptible handheld breathing.

This is a small release of effort,
performed with complete confidence.

Cut after the fingers settle into the lighter grip.


SHOT Z03 — THE WATCHING MASK
00:07–00:11

65mm tight three-quarter close-up of Zahhak’s mask
and the nearest living shoulder serpent.

Camera remains on the established side,
slightly below his face.

Zahhak’s mask occupies CENTER-LEFT.
His face points toward SCREEN RIGHT and slightly upward.

The nearest living serpent’s head is visible beside the mask,
separated from its outline by a narrow interval of black.

The overhead spotlight catches the upper mask ridge
and small sections of the serpent’s scales.
The lower mask stays in deep shadow.

During the first two seconds, the serpent slowly turns its head
toward the suspended women off-screen right.

Zahhak then tilts his entire masked head by approximately
five degrees, as if quietly assessing his control over them.

The rigid mask moves with his head as one solid unit.
His shoulders stay relaxed.

Use intimate handheld stillness.
Maintain the mask and serpent within a readable focus range.

The raised staff remains in his right hand below the crop.

Hold his quiet, unreadable attention through the cut.


SHOT Z04 — THE RELATIONSHIP OF POWER
00:11–00:15

28mm low-angle wide shot from the same side of the action axis.
Camera begins approximately 50 centimeters above the floor.

Show Zahhak full-length at SCREEN LEFT, facing right.
His feet are planted directly on the smooth continuous floor.
His staff remains raised in his right hand.

Show Shahrnaz full-length at CENTER-RIGHT, nearer the camera,
facing left and holding the cat against her chest.

Show Arnavaz full-length in the deeper RIGHT position,
also facing left.

Both women remain suspended 1.2 meters above the floor.
Separate their silhouettes clearly.
Keep both pairs of feet and the empty space beneath them visible.

The camera retreats approximately 40 centimeters over four seconds,
with slight handheld imbalance.

As the frame opens, reveal more of the uninterrupted flat floor
linking Zahhak’s grounded feet to the space beneath the sisters.

A strong pulse of airflow snaps the women’s loose garments
upward and sideways.
Their hair streams in the same localized current.

Arnavaz’s fingers tremble.
Shahrnaz keeps the cat securely supported.

Zahhak watches them without changing his stance.
His costume remains heavy and almost still.
His shoulder serpents continue small independent movements.

Hold this contrast:
one grounded figure exercising effortless control,
two suspended figures enduring the force.

Finish with the staff still raised,
both women still suspended,
and the wind still active.

The final frame remains inside the scene,
ready to cut into further levitation details or the descent.


SOUND

Maintain a continuous physical sound bed across all four shots:

Strong air movement around the women.
Irregular snapping and fluttering of their garments.
Their restrained, strained breathing.

Close to Zahhak:
slow breathing,
a faint creak as his grip relaxes,
one soft movement of scales against heavy fabric.

Sound perspective changes naturally with each camera position.
The wind remains more distant during Zahhak’s close-ups
and becomes immediate again in the final wide shot.

Continue the sound through the last frame for editing continuity.

NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.

Established requirements for this subject:
- No human appears without a mask. Every person on screen, including nobles, gift-bearers, servants and background figures, wears a mask. A figure who is not a named character takes one of the masked caste looks in REF-001, Civilization Caste Board. Never show a bare human face.

<<<image_1>>> is Zahhak (CHR-001 V08); match it wherever Zahhak appears.
<<<image_2>>> is Arnavaz (CHR-004 V01); match it wherever Arnavaz appears.
<<<image_3>>> is Shahrnaz (CHR-005 V01); match it wherever Shahrnaz appears.
<<<image_4>>> is Cat Persian Longhair (CRT-004 V01); match it wherever Cat Persian Longhair appears.
<<<image_5>>> is Dagger Horse Head (PRP-019 V02); match it wherever Dagger Horse Head appears.
<<<image_6>>> is Staff - Bronze Cobra (PRP-001 V01); match it wherever Staff - Bronze Cobra appears.
